chapter: Billie Holiday, Basie leadership and studio work
title: What Royal was and wasn't responsible for in Basie's band
summary: He denies the book's claims that he policed drinking and buses; he cared only about the music.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: In the Basie Band, back to the book by ______, it says here that, "Among your responsibilities were to see that nobody got too juiced, nobody played too late at dance sessions, everybody got on the bus on time." Did you have to worry about all those things?
I would never be involved in anything like
That is anybody's worry other than mine. I don't fool with no crap. I'm a musician.
Your concern is strictly the musical performance?
Right. Anybody's personal happenings, what they do out overnight after they get off the job, that's their business and whoever wants to know less about it, I am that person.
